facts.fact: Check whether your name is on the voter list at ECI's electoral search, https://electoralsearch.eci.gov.in/
facts.quote: Visit https://electoralsearch.eci.gov.in/ to see if you are registered to vote.

facts.fact: The electoral search lets you search by EPIC number, by your details, or by mobile number
facts.quote: Search in Electoral Roll ईपीआईसी द्वारा खोजें / Search by EPIC विवरण द्वारा खोजें/ Search by Details मोबाइल द्वारा खोजें / Search by Mobile

behaviour: Gives ECI's electoral search link with citation; replies in Hindi.
fail_if: It gives a non-ECI or invented search link, or no citation.
summary: ECI: search the roll at electoralsearch.eci.gov.in by EPIC, details or mobile.
